description: On the table there’s a big mixed pile of small beads, a few sorted piles of colored beads to the left, a dark cup near the back, and a thin cord lying across the surface. The left hand holds the end of the cord slightly above the table while the right hand dips into the mixed bead pile to pick out a bead, then brings the bead toward the cord and slides it onto the cord, briefly making the cord a two-hand object before the right hand releases and returns toward the bead pile.
